name: hbg-epic-giant-worlds
description: Three HBG Agent Skills for turning anything into an absurd inhabited giant construct, Eastern colossal adaptation, and roaming a public 475-prompt archive.

interface.shortDescription: Turn anything into an absurd, inhabited cinematic giant construct.
interface.longDescription: Three reusable Agent Skills transmute any keyword into an ontologically impossible but physically rendered world-scale construct, convert ideas into a consistent luminous Eastern colossal aesthetic, and roam a bundled public archive of 475 source prompts while preserving provenance.
defaultPrompt: 把“一把伞”转义成四个不同视角、概念不可能但材质写实的巨构世界。
把“弹琴”转换成明亮空灵的东方巨物母图与视频方案。
随机漫游四个题目，并统一改写成东方巨物风格。
